title: Marathon Handbook — Phil Gore wins the 2025 Backyard Ultra world title
claims: Phil Gore (Australia) won the 2025 Big's Backyard Ultra World Championships in Bell Buckle, Tennessee, completing 114 laps of the 6.7 km course, about 764 km over nearly five days.
Belgium's Ivo Steyaert kept pace for 113 laps before dropping in the 113th hour, leaving Gore to run one final solo lap to seal the title.
Britain's Sarah Perry set a women's Backyard Ultra world record of 95 laps (about 637 km), surpassing the previous mark of 87 laps; back pain forced her to stop.
Gore already held the overall Backyard Ultra world record of 119 laps (about 797 km), achieved earlier in 2025 at the Dead Cow Gully Backyard Masters in Queensland, Australia.
